name: Invalid Transaction Fuzzing
description: Fires deliberately-invalid transactions (bad chainid/nonce/gas/fees, malformed RLP, empty 7702 auth, blobless blob tx) from a small reused pool of burner wallets, out-of-pool and fire-and-forget. A node accepting one is a potential validation gap.

name: Transaction Layer Fuzzing
description: Sends well-formed transactions across all types (legacy/2930/1559/4844/7702) with randomized calldata, access lists, authorizations, blobs and targets.

name: EVM Execution Fuzzing
description: Deploys contracts with randomly generated, stack-aware bytecode exercising opcodes and precompiles.

name: Fuzzing
description: A mix of fuzzing scenarios - EVM execution fuzzing (random bytecode deployments) and transaction-layer fuzzing (randomized tx types, calldata, access lists, authorizations and blobs) - sharing a global budget of 10 tx/slot to surface consensus and validation bugs.

name: Seaport NFT Trades
description: Deploys Seaport 1.6 and fulfills signed NFT buy and sell orders against a market counterparty.

name: ENS Name Registrations
description: Deploys the real ENS contract stack and organically registers, renews, updates and churns names, naming all spamoor wallets on the host.

name: Aave V3 Lending
description: Deploys a full Aave V3 market and organically supplies, borrows, repays and withdraws two tokens, with oracle price moves and occasional liquidations.

name: Blob Transactions
description: Sends type-3 blob transactions as part of the shared chain load.

name: Uniswap V3 Swaps
description: Swaps tokens across Uniswap V3 pools (0.3% fee tier).

name: Uniswap V2 Swaps
description: Swaps tokens across Uniswap V2 pairs.

name: Curve StableSwap Swaps
description: Performs token swaps on Curve StableSwap pools.

name: Safe Multisig Executions
description: Executes transactions through Safe (Gnosis) multisig wallets.

name: ERC-4337 Account Abstraction
description: Submits ERC-4337 UserOperations through the EntryPoint via a bundler.

name: ERC-721 NFT Activity
description: Mints and transfers ERC-721 non-fungible tokens.

name: ERC-20 Token Transfers
description: Deploys an ERC-20 token and continuously transfers it between wallets.

name: EOA Transfers
description: Plain ETH value transfers between externally-owned accounts.

name: Regular Chain Load
description: A balanced mix of everyday transaction types - EOA transfers, ERC-20/721/1155 tokens, ERC-4337 account abstraction, Safe multisig, Curve / Uniswap V2+V3 swaps, blobs, Aave V3 lending, ENS name registrations and Seaport NFT trades - sharing a global budget of 100 tx/slot to emulate organic chain activity.

name: EVM Fuzz Spammer
description: Opcode & Precompile fuzzer, 50tx/block, gas limit 1M, ~20M gas usage

name: Uniswap V2 Swap Spammer
description: 200 type-2 swap transactions with uniswap v2 pools, gas limit 20 gwei, ~15M gas usage

name: Gas Burner Spammer
description: 20 gas-burner transactions per slot, burning 2M gas each, gas limit 20 gwei, up to 40M gas usage

name: Big Block Spammer
description: 200 type-2 eoa transactions per slot with 25k zero bytes calldata each

name: Blob Average Spammer
description: Maintains a steady average of ~3 blobs per block

name: ERC20 Transaction Spammer
description: 215 type-2 erc20 transactions per slot, gas limit 20 gwei, 8.4M gas usage

name: EOA Transaction Spammer
description: 400 type-2 eoa transactions per slot, gas limit 20 gwei, 8.4M gas usage
